latest_census.notes: The 2007 Population and Housing Census asked religion, ethnic group and mother tongue (search snippet: 'collected data on ... religion, mother tongue, ethnic group'; 85 ethnic groups and 87 mother tongues reported). All three were published subnationally by region, zone and woreda in the CSA statistical reports. The 4th census (planned 2017) was never held; a 2024 SJI paper on the Post-Enumeration Survey says officials 'put off the population and housing census until the third and final year of the project (through 2026)'. No search result shows a 4th census enumerated as of 2026-09-10. Ethiopia's Statistical Service published the national 2007 report PDF at ess.gov.et in June 2026.

tier_reason: The 2007 census counted religion, ethnicity and mother tongue and the USCB/HDX workbook publishes all three by region (13) and zone (93) as XLSX; the repo already reads it and has 11/11 admin1 and 72/74 admin2 filled. No newer count exists: the 4th census has still not been held.
recommended_action: Nothing to replace: the HDX/USCB 2007 workbook is the best and only subnational count and is already built. The two unfilled admin2 shapes (and Sidama/Region 17) are boundary-vintage gaps, not source gaps -- the regional CSA PDF volumes could confirm zone figures for renamed zones (e.g. Gamo Gofa -> Gamo/Gofa) but add no field. Re-check ess.gov.et when the 4th census is actually enumerated; as of September 2026 search results only show it deferred 'through 2026'.

summary: Ethiopia's last completed census is 2007; it asked religion, ethnic group and mother tongue and the U.S. Census Bureau's HDX workbook publishes all three by 13 first-order areas and 93 zones as XLSX -- the exact source the repo already reads, filling 11/11 admin1 and 72/74 admin2 shapes. The 4th census has not been held (deferred 'through 2026' per a 2024 PES feasibility paper), so nothing newer exists to replace it. ESS has now put the 2007 national report PDF on ess.gov.et and the IPUMS microdata subset is catalogued on the World Bank library, but neither adds a field or a level. Wikipedia zone articles (e.g. Horo Guduru Welega) quote 2007 census ethnic shares in their body text, which would only matter for the two unfilled zone shapes and renamed zones such as Gamo Gofa.
